title: An environment file is served (/.env.development)
summary: An environment file holds database credentials, API keys and other secrets in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("APP_") or body_contains("DB_") or body_contains("SECRET")) and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Keep environment files out of the web root and rotate any exposed secrets.
